title: Definition-Guided In-Context Learning for Zero-Shot Spoken Language Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.28929v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting spoken language understanding (SLU) systems to novel or revised label taxonomies conventionally requires additional labeled data and retraining, creating a bottleneck for real world deployment. While in-context learning with few-shot demonstrations offers an alternative, multi-modal generalization and scaling has been challenging. In this work, we investigate whether natural-language definitions alone can guide zero-shot SLU without demonstration exemplars, finding that symbolic definitions serve as the primary supervisory driver for adapting speech-text models. We operationalize this principle as Definition-Guided In-Context Learning (DG-ICL), a fine-tuning framework that decouples semantic categories from fixed lexical names. translated_title: 面向零样本口语理解的定义引导上下文学习
translated_abstract: 让口语理解（SLU）系统适配全新或经过修订的标签体系，传统上需要额外的标注数据和重新训练，这为现实世界的部署造成了瓶颈。虽然基于少样本示例的上下文学习提供了一种替代方案，但多模态的泛化与规模化一直面临挑战。在本工作中，我们研究了仅凭自然语言定义、在没有演示样本的情况下能否引导零样本SLU，发现符号化定义是适配语音-文本模型的主要监督驱动力。我们将这一原理具体化为定义引导的上下文学习（DG-ICL），这是一个将语义类别与固定词汇名称解耦的微调框架。通过用动态随机化的定义（在DG-ICL-Sym中使用任意合成词元，在DG-ICL-Flip中使用置换后的词汇词）替换标签，DG-ICL避免了词汇捷径，并鼓励模型……
tldr: 该论文提出定义引导的上下文学习框架DG-ICL，通过用动态随机化定义（合成词元或置换词汇）替换固定标签，使语音-文本模型仅凭自然语言定义即可实现零样本口语理解，摆脱对标注数据和少样本示例的依赖。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DG-ICL, a fine-tuning framework that replaces fixed labels with dynamically randomized definitions (synthetic tokens or permuted vocabulary words), enabling speech-text models to achieve zero-shot spoken language understanding guided by natural-language definitions alone, without requiring demonstration exemplars or retraining.
